blocks.text: A crown of stars in a "wheel within a wheel" like angelic wings is in "Capstone" top. God's web of destiny is woven into it, Jesus designed the beautiful house of the man child! - (This design was created before the Temple was made!)
Rev. 10:4,7 “But in the days of the voice, (message) of the 7th. Angel, when he shall begin to sound (Thunder) the mystery of God should be finished. (in verse 4)
Also it is contained in the Scripture, "Behold I lay in Sion a chief corner stone (elect precious) a royal priesthood! (I Peter 2:6-9)
“The Kings Scroll” We’re nearing the midnight cry!

If one looks at this pattern and design you can see that it is woven in a mysterious web of providence. Only the Creator could spin such a mysterious wonder! You can see scores of mysterious symbols and signs. — Truly a spiritual and revelative meaning! If you turn it sideways you can see a star! It depends which way you turn it you get all the hidden realizations. You can see stars within stars! ~ “We have also a more sure word of prophecy whereunto ye do well that ye take heed — and ‘the day star’ arise in your hearts! (II Peter 1:19)
